subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue close with a larger fixed Control UI history window, or should closure require a load-older pagination path that uses Gateway history continuation metadata?
rationale: Current source confirms the limitation and the backend pagination surface, but docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for stability, so the UX/performance tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch and expose older history pages while preserving a bounded initial payload.

options.title: Accept a coordinated fixed window
options.body: Allow closure after a PR intentionally raises both fetch and render behavior with proof that the larger window is the desired product tradeoff.

options.title: Defer to the broader pagination PR
options.body: Treat the open broader pagination PR as the canonical implementation path and keep this issue open until that branch lands or is replaced.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch and expose older history pages while preserving a bounded initial payload.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete has adjacent chat.history cursor work and is the clearest owner signal for the public Gateway history semantics tradeoff.
